records.text: A local source told Owens that the gun was found in a backyard by a chicken coop.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #4 (Ep sreYYcID-QY)

appearances.snippet: And this person tells me: actually, the gun was found in the backyard of someone that I know. We all know each other. And it was found by a chicken coop.

verification.notes: Official reports and court documents describe the gun as being found in woods/bushes near UVU campus, wrapped in a towel. Text messages from Robinson mention leaving the rifle 'in a bush.' While the general area matches (gun found in residential area near campus), there is no mention of a 'chicken coop' in any official reports, only in this local source's account. The gun was found in wooded area, not specifically at a chicken coop.

records.text: Local residents theorized, without proof, that the vacant university-owned house next to where the gun was found was where the true shooter ran.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #4 (Ep sreYYcID-QY)

appearances.snippet: The locals are theorizing— ... again, we have no proof of this, ... they're not being honest about the fact that the house right next door to where the gun was found is a mysteriously vacant home that is owned by the university itself, and that that is where they believe that the true shooter ran to following the assassination of Charlie (Charlie Kirk).

verification.notes: This is explicitly presented as hearsay/theory from locals ('locals are theorizing', 'we have no proof of this', 'this is what they are saying'). The speaker is attributing this claim to others, not asserting it as fact. The existence of a vacant university-owned property near where the gun was found cannot be verified through public records without specific property addresses. As stated theory/speculation rather than factual assertion, this cannot be verified.
